payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes factorials for combinations. Uses 1D DP (u[i]) to accumulate weighted contributions of digit positions with powers of 10 and combinatorial choices of plus placements.
payload.rationale: The DP state is one-dimensional (index i). The recurrence u[i] = p[i]*C(...)+u[i-1] builds prefix sums, typical of dp_1d_state. Combinatorics only provide coefficients, not multi-dimensional state.
